adamw_schedule: 5% linear warmup, cosine decay to 1% initial LR over allotted updates
accounting: fixed declared arithmetic cost per training update; excludes augmentation/preprocessing, validation, checkpoint I/O and precision-management overhead
precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast, FP32 parameters/optimizer; CPU smoke tests FP32
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation macro hard Dice over classes 1 and 2 at fixed compute milestones
name: compute_matched_constraints_20261004_unet_pilot
pilot_scope: Four U-Net objectives, fold 0, seed 0. Expansion requires a later user request.
calibration_policy: 50 Dice-only training updates remain part of each constrained run. Calibrate on all ten training patients, no augmentation or validation; target median logit-gradient RMS ratio .1 with p95 cap .5. Edge is calibrated against Dice plus weighted bands when applicable.
budget_accounting: Dice prefix, all calibration attempts, and all subsequent training attempts charged within the exact reference budget.
training_loss: Dice + constraint_scale * (connected_zero + band_weight * bands + edge_weight * original_edge); missing terms omitted
constraint_scale: After 50 Dice prefix updates, ramp from 1/50 to 1 over 50 constrained updates. Constraint losses are computed and charged throughout this ramp.
sources: Original edge consistency only; canonical two-step BCE bands with gamma=0 and degree_alpha=0
